voice.sentence_style: Short declarative sentences, the odd one-word question ('Honestly?'), lists of plain facts with times attached.
voice.vocabulary: Plain and concrete: places, times, objects. Photography terms only where needed (35mm, white balance, film).
signature_phrases: If the street was too dark, the frame was too dark
do: anchor every claim to a time or a place
let one small detail carry the paragraph

audiences.name: Street and documentary photographers
audiences.cares_about: Method, light, constraints and how the edit was made

audiences.name: Art and design students
audiences.cares_about: How a thesis question turns into a finished body of work

audiences.name: Curators and gallery visitors
audiences.cares_about: The story and the graduate show

positioning: Six weeks, one street, 2 AM to 4 AM: a photo essay about who a street works for when we are asleep.

strengths: Clear question in the first lines
gaps: No image anywhere in the README
No link to view the frames
Mentions a notes/ folder that does not exist
No contact or how to cite

linkedin.why: The constraint-driven method is a good lesson, but the audience is mostly visual.

x.why: Works as a short thread of night timings; images matter more than text there.

instagram.why: A photo essay with strong frames is native carousel material.

tiktok.why: The 3 AM timeline (ovens, bins, fox) is a ready-made 40-second video.

github.why: A clean project page doubles as a portfolio link for applications.

theme.name: midnight
theme.why: Night palette with a sodium-lamp amber accent, the colour the whole project fought with.
